subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the guard fixes and exact-head checks pass, should these credential-bearing action revisions be approved as one grouped security-sensitive dependency update?
rationale: The diff updates third-party actions that receive repository credentials and scanning permissions; automated tests can validate integration but cannot decide the repository's acceptance of the reviewed upstream code.

options.title: Approve repaired group
options.body: Land the grouped bump after guard synchronization, green exact-head checks, and security-owner review of the upstream revisions.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, registry, Codex, and scanning actions into smaller updates for independent security review.

options.title: Defer the group
options.body: Postpone the update if the grouped upstream review cost outweighs the maintenance benefit.

recommendation.title: Approve repaired group
recommendation.body: Land the grouped bump after guard synchronization, green exact-head checks, and security-owner review of the upstream revisions.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns the most security-sensitive changed workflows to this team.
